pitch: Cursor helps developers write code. The tracker shows how their development actually went.
productSeparation: The recorder reports observed, source-reported and explicitly estimated facts per Git branch. It does not claim causal savings, productivity gains, human waiting time or AI code ownership. CI/CD and GitHub are out of scope.
forbiddenCopyPattern: (time|hours|money|cost) saved|savings of|productivity (gain|boost|increase)|\bROI\b|\d+x faster|human waiting|per shipped feature|ai[- ]written code

claims.readme: Token usage: input, output, reasoning, cached
claims.evidence: docs/execution/c14/live/analyze.json: input 25599, output 1381, cached-input 122880 equal the cursor-agent stream result.usage; reasoning unavailable (cursor-agent does not report it); total unavailable by design (no aggregate ledger).

Live cursor-agent reports no charge; dx.cost.charge.usd unavailable with reason 'Not zero'. Price-table estimate is method=price-table:cursor@2026-09 and stays unavailable because the model was not in the table. A charge needs a user-selected Cursor usage CSV/dashboard export.

claims.readme: Track AI usage per feature or branch
claims.evidence: Selector repo+branch feature/c14-live; branch comes from collect context (cursor-cli gap no-branch-in-cli-output is disclosed).
dx.flight.tool-calls=24 vs 12 completed calls in the stream (C09 finding 2 / C14 gap). Do not quote this number in the demo until fixed.
dx.git.files-changed 2, lines +16/-0, commits 1 (live); C07 golden +48/-8 over 2 files.
local-test junit: live 1 run/0 failures; adversarial 1 run/1 failure. Only locally selected junit files; no CI.

claims.readme: Rework: how much code had to be changed again
claims.evidence: git.files-retouched and friction.reworked-files exist but disagree on the adversarial flight (1 vs 0, C14 gap). No 'Rework %' metric exists; README's 27% figure is illustrative only.

claims.readme: Development time / agent activity over time
claims.evidence: Separate metrics: branch-age (wall clock, partial while unmerged), active.ms (idle-gap intervals), agent.ms (merged agent intervals). None is labelled human waiting.
No merge/ship detection beyond local git; no charge in live flight. README example table is illustrative, not recorder output.
Real cursor-agent run with project .cursor/hooks.json installed and uninstalled; ~/.cursor/hooks.json hash unchanged. Cursor IDE not exercised.
